content: We-ibmar-gusad bela-bela Jonás-sae-itogega imaksad. Sae-itogedba, sabsur-uluded.

Geb Jonás, Bab-Jehováʼse goted. Weyob ega sogded: —Bab-Jehová, ¿ar an we-obarissursi, deunni an-yargi an gudigu? Agala, an Tarsis-neggweburse nadegusanad. Ar an nue-wisid, be, Bab-Dummad-emar-saberbadid, be, wile-emar-dakedid. Be wissur-gwae-gwae urwebalidid. Ar be, dulemar-nue-sabsoggu, emar-sabsur-odurdakoye be sogdaenad, degite, be sorba sogdedabalid, be-isgued bergusye.
Bab-Jehováʼye, degisoggu, an bega soged, bur be an-oburgwesunna. Bur an dula-gudiidba burgwisunnana gadinad.
Bab-Jehová, Jonás-abin sogded: —Ar weyob be urwenaidde, ¿ibmar-nued na be sanaye sogsunde? Gwen ibmar-nuedsulid.
Geb Jonás neggweburgi nodegusad, dad-nakwedsik sigwidapid. Agi, neg-matarkwaa sobsad. A-neg-urba, negsichigwagi sigisad. Geb neggwebursik ataksii gusad, adi, dakegar, igi Nínive-neggwebur gudodibeye.

Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová Jonás-siidgi dagargii-dakleged-urwa dunguega imaksad, adi, Jonás a-urwa-urba dukuegar, degine, urwesiidbali wis yeer-itobaligar. Agi Jonás, we-urwa-urba-dukusiidgi yeer-itos-gusad.
Neg-oiboargua, Bab-Dummad, dagargii-dakleged-urwa nusse gullegega imaksad. Degisoggu, urwa dingussunnad.

Dad nakwiargu, Bab-Dummad, dad-nakwedsikid-burwa diopisur-golega imaksad. Degisoggu, Jonásʼgi dad-dummadi-ganai-gualid. Degidbali, Jonás, sulibinsa-ito-naded, na neg negoe-itoged. Agala, burgwebi-guarsunnad, geb, weyob sogded: “Bitigi an burgwissunnana gadina, ar dula-gudiidba bur-nuedid.”
Agine, Bab-Dummaddi Jonásʼga sogded: —¿Ar dagargii-dakleged-dingusadbina nue be urwe? Jonás, Bab-Dummad-abin sogded: —Eye, nue-bela-bela an sae-itoged.

Geb degine, Bab-Jehová Jonásʼga sogdebalid: —¿We-dagargii-dakleged-urwa, mutiki-dungusad, a-banedgine, mutiki burgwisbalid, a-bina be bukib-binsade? Emide be, gwen digsasulid, be gwen odummossurbalid.

Ar deyob be itogele, an-bulesunna, ¿ar an Nínive-neggwebur wiledakosur be an-insae? Ar we-Nínive-neggwebur-dummadgi dulemar-aku-neg-itomalad mili-dulanergwa-gaka (120,000+) bukwad, degine, moli-bebe-nikamalad bukidar-bukwabalid. ¿Amarde an wiledakosursi? An wile dakoed.
